Container.Name: OptiKeep-Worker
Container.Overview: Read-only analysis worker. Install a coordinator separately; use the same daemon token and media mapping.
Container.Description: Read-only OptiKeep development preview for Linux amd64.

Config.Name: Daemon token
Config.Description: Create a worker token in a terminal: openssl rand -hex 32. Use the same worker token on the coordinator and all workers; keep it different from the administrator token.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Select the same media directory for coordinator and workers; read-only.
